messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑look calendar of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday, giving you a three‑day break that includes the adjacent weekend.)

| # | Holiday (Canada) | Date 2023 | Day of Week | Weekend Days Included |
|---|------------------|-----------|-------------|-----------------------|
| 1 | **Family Day** (Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | Feb 20 | Monday | Feb 18–20 |
| 2 | **Good Friday** | Apr 7 | Friday | Apr 7–9 |
| 3 | **Victoria Day** | May 22 | Monday | May 20–22 |
| 4 | **Civic Holiday** (Ontario, etc.) | Aug 7 | Monday | Aug 5–7 |
| 5 | **Labour Day** | Sep 4 | Monday | Sep 2–4 |
| 6 | **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 | Monday | Oct 7–9 |
| 7 | **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 | Monday | Nov 9–11 |
| 8 | **Christmas** | Dec 25 | Monday | Dec 23–25 |

> **Notes**  
> • Some provinces observe additional holidays that also create long weekends (e.g., *St. Patrick’s Day* in Newfoundland & Labrador, *St. John’s Day* in Prince Edward Island).  
> • Canada Day (Jul 1) fell on a Saturday, so it was already part of a weekend; it’s listed here only for completeness.  
> • Boxing Day (Dec 26) fell on a Tuesday, so it did not create a long weekend.

Feel free to copy/paste the table into your holiday‑planning app or use the data as a starting point for generating reminders, travel bookings, or itinerary suggestions!
